reuse.why: Extends the existing pre-link guard that every provider linker already calls instead of adding a separate check per linker.

duplication.why: The closed-account check is written once inside the shared guard; nothing is repeated across the six linkers.

placement.why: The rule sits in the pre-link validation helper in accounts/app.ts, before any write or sync, which is where the tree already puts link preconditions.

scope.why: Focused on the rule plus tests; renaming the guard touches all six call sites, which is justified by its widened meaning but adds churn.

maintainability.why: All link preconditions now live in one aptly named function, so the next rule change is a single edit.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six linkers (goCardless, simpleFin, pluggyai, akahu, fintegra, enableBanking) go through assertCanLinkBankAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the check exists only in assertCanLinkBankAccount.

one_place.where: assertCanLinkBankAccount in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by every *-accounts-link handler.
